Hi Everyone,

While reducing a batch of 10 files, I keep receiving the following warnings (30 warnings in total):

Warning messages:
1: In match_loc:(match_loc + (ws2/ws3) - 1) :
  numerical expression has 2 elements: only the first used

Despite the warning, I get all the outputs for part 4, including part 4 outputs (part4_summary_sleep_cleaned.csv, part4_nightsummary_sleep_cleaned.csv, part4_nightsummary_sleep_full.csv and part4_summary_sleep_full.csv). 

The warnings seem to relate to the plotting of non-wear time and sleep periods.

Best,

Dominika
